target.title: fix(providers): bind cleanup to live cloud ownership
target.body:
## Summary

- require an exact region-bound local claim before direct AWS cleanup, including provider-key binding
- re-read AWS, Azure, and GCP resources immediately before deletion and bind cleanup to immutable provider identities
- revalidate Azure companion resources across retries, including attached snapshot quarantine NSGs, without inferring detached ownership from mutable tags
- retain recoverable GCP claims when a live instance still exists but ownership labels drift

Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/871
Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/880

## Verification

- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./internal/providers/aws ./internal/providers/azure ./internal/providers/gcp`
- `go test ./internal/cli -run 'Test(AWSCleanup|RetryAzureCleanupResourceReads)' -count=1`
- `go test ./internal/cli -run '^TestControllerFailedProviderStateCleansBeforeFailed$' -count=3`
- `git diff --check`

## Live proof

- AWS direct, eu-west-1: provisioned `cbx_c48f517a0cb3` / `i-0343230e8d53646f7`, changed the live provider-key tag, and confirmed cleanup retained both the instance and exact claim. After restoring the binding, cleanup terminated the instance, deleted the immutable key-pair ID, removed the claim, and left no active instance residue. Repeated the lifecycle on final head `e108e06d` with `cbx_9ccd82d11b0b` / `i-04dd6ec0ed943dee2`; `aws-exact-head-e108e06d-ok` ran successfully and cleanup again removed the instance, key pair, and claim.
- GCP direct, europe-west2-a: provisioned `cbx_8fc61e2ba54e` / instance ID `2266999748930549101`, ran the exact-head marker, changed ownership labels, and confirmed cleanup retained the live instance and exact claim. After restoring ownership, cleanup removed the instance and claim with zero residue.
- Azure direct, eastus: provisioned `cbx_8251c6e15549` / `crabbox-cleanup-azure-0b0f-4d3dc82b`, ran `azure-exact-head-fbd0630f-ok`, changed live ownership, and confirmed cleanup retained the VM and exact claim. After restoring ownership, cleanup removed the VM, NIC, public IP, managed disk, claim, and all failed-canary prefix residue.

No new credentials or configuration are required.
